newsitem.title: USA: Ashland to redeem 6.75 pct debentures.
newsitem.headline: Ashland to redeem 6.75 pct debentures.

text.p: Ashland Inc said Tuesday it has called for redemption on July 3 its outstanding 6.75 percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2014.
In accordance with the terms of the debentures, the redemption price will be 101.350 percent of the principal amount plus accrued interest to the redemption date.
Ashland noted the debentures may be converted into common at a price of $51.34 per share any time before the close of business on July 3.

When the call premium and accrual of unpaid interest to be paid on redemption are considered, Ashland said, holders would receive a greater value choosing the redemption option, provided that the market price of the company's common were below $52.06 per share.
The stock was at 48-1/8, up 1/2, in early afternoon trading.

Assuming no conversions occured prior to the redemption of the debentures, 2.42 million Ashland common shares currently reserved for issuance upon conversion would be eliminated, the company said. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
